operations.description: Execute trusted lmcode bytecode against ONNX, FAISS and AutoFaiss; may modify indexes, models and files. Dry-run verifies loading without executing the body or rules.
operations.name: run

params.description: Path to a DSLB v6 program
params.name: program

operations.description: Index a list of files and directories into a FAISS index using downloaded/cached ONNX model weights, common filter flags, or lmcode (@file_filter / @config / @embed) callbacks.
operations.name: index

params.description: Model identifier or URL to download/cache
params.name: model

params.description: Path to compiled lmcode DSLB v6 file with @file_filter / @config / @embed callbacks
params.name: lmcode

operations.description: Search text against a persisted FAISS index using common CLI filter flags (--ext, --path-prefix, --path-contains, --exclude-path, --contains, --field, --min-score, --max-distance) and/or lmcode (@config, @filter, @rerank) callbacks (--lmcode).
operations.name: search

params.description: Path to saved FAISS index file
params.name: index

params.description: Number of top hits to return
params.name: k

params.description: Path to compiled lmcode DSLB v6 file with @config / @filter / @rerank callbacks
params.name: lmcode

operations.description: Launch a single-user global-session REST server with lazy in-memory indexing, cached broad search hits, fast refined filter views, idle timeout auto-shutdown, and weights-only disk caching.
operations.name: serve

params.description: File to write the bound TCP port once listening
params.name: port-file

params.description: Idle timeout in seconds before automatic server shutdown
params.name: timeout

params.description: Cache only ONNX model weights on disk; start index and result cache clean in RAM
params.name: weights-only-cache

params.description: Model identifier or URL to download/cache
params.name: model

operations.description: Query, refine filter, requery cached memory view, or shut down a running lmsearch REST server.
operations.name: client

params.description: Base URL of the lmsearch REST server
params.name: url

params.description: Number of top hits to return
params.name: k
